changes.CANADA_SCRATCH_KV_FORMAT=v41: KV caches in the reference implementation's own formats: a V4.1 sliding-window cache (e4m3, one ue8m0 scale per 32; 528 B/token) and a V4.1-FP4 compressed cache (e2m1, one e4m3 scale per 16; 288 B/token), about half the bytes per token
changes.attention kernels (with v41): above 8 rows: an adapted open-source prefill sparse-attention kernel (MIT; keys packed in shared memory, exactly widened to f16 in registers); at 8 rows and below: FlashInfer v0.7.3 DeepSeek-V4.1 split decode with fp32 partials
changes.CANADA_SCRATCH_SESSION_CACHE_SLOTS=16, C: up to 16 resident conversation images; usable bytes are limited to 4 GiB by the shared image budget (the one-bank maximum), which holds four ~600K-token conversations, or two of four at ~920K; every save is still admitted against real memory above the floor

kernel_checks.store_kernels: bit-exact against the reference quantizers on GB10 (window and compressed caches)
kernel_checks.attention: outputs within bf16 rounding of a float64 oracle (relative error 0.0022-0.0023)

reference_quality_note: teacher-forced KL(reference || engine) per token against the reference forward, beside a split-K yardstick (the reference with its sums reordered) on the same 5,499-token text

prefill_same_window.note: cold, source-code prompts, one load each, same window (build vs build)

residency_check.flags: 6 GiB session cache under the 4 GiB shared-image cap (effective 4 GiB, as released); 5 GiB test floor, not reached

residency_limit_near_1m.flags: release: 16 slots, 5 GiB session cache, 4 GiB shared-image cap, 8 GiB floor

memory_floor_test.stage1: one box, engine stopped: allocations reclaimed page cache smoothly down to 3.5 GiB available; no stalls, driver errors or OOM kills
memory_floor_test.stage2: full stress panel with 4.5 GiB extra held on every box: passed; lowest available 5.9 GiB

stress_panel_first_attempt.result: stopped at a test-fixture check, not an engine fault: the check required the two parked long conversations to total more than 2 GiB, a bar sized for the V4 cache; in the V4.1/FP4 layout each image is about half as large
stress_panel_first_attempt.fix: the check now judges the pair from the parked images themselves; the full panel was rerun
